proposal.reason: Main change is CI workflow execution correctness: `.github/workflows/build-artifactory-ppu.yml` adds authenticated registry pull, branch-paired `pccl-tests` resolution with fallback, and dispatch-time commit pinning logic, which changes how builds/tests are selected and run. `.github/workflows/source-sanity.yml` and `pccl-daily-full.yml` propagate resolved `pccl-tests` revision/branch through cache validation and runner checks, and `.github/workflows/scripts/pccl_for_test_hggcrt13_ubuntu24_build.sh` adjusts CI build pass ordering/env for unit-test linking in that workflow context. These are test/build orchestration behaviors owned by **ci**, not review-policy automation (`workflow`) or core product modules.
